covenant_services_unpublished_no_price.name: covenant_services_unpublished_no_price
covenant_services_unpublished_no_price.value: "covenant_services"."published" or ("covenant_services"."price_low_zar" is null and "covenant_services"."price_high_zar" is null)

covenant_services_price_range.name: covenant_services_price_range
covenant_services_price_range.value: "covenant_services"."price_high_zar" is null or ("covenant_services"."price_low_zar" is not null and "covenant_services"."price_high_zar" >= "covenant_services"."price_low_zar")

companies_domain_normalised.name: companies_domain_normalised
companies_domain_normalised.value: "companies"."domain" is null or ("companies"."domain" = lower("companies"."domain") and "companies"."domain" !~ '^www\.' and "companies"."domain" !~ '[/:@\s]' and "companies"."domain" ~ '\.')

companies_merge_consistent.name: companies_merge_consistent
companies_merge_consistent.value: ("companies"."status" = 'merged') = ("companies"."merged_into_id" is not null) and "companies"."merged_into_id" is distinct from "companies"."id"

company_merges_unmerge_complete.name: company_merges_unmerge_complete
company_merges_unmerge_complete.value: ("company_merges"."unmerged_at" is null) = ("company_merges"."unmerged_by" is null) and ("company_merges"."unmerged_at" is null) = ("company_merges"."unmerge_reason" is null)

source_records_fetch_fields.name: source_records_fetch_fields
source_records_fetch_fields.value: ("source_records"."retrieval_method" = 'http_fetch') = ("source_records"."purpose" is not null and "source_records"."host" is not null and "source_records"."user_agent" is not null)

source_records_blocked_proof.name: source_records_blocked_proof
source_records_blocked_proof.value: "source_records"."fetch_outcome" <> 'SOURCE_BLOCKED' or ("source_records"."robots_source_record_id" is not null and "source_records"."http_status" is null and "source_records"."raw_content" is null)

source_records_human_attributed.name: source_records_human_attributed
source_records_human_attributed.value: "source_records"."retrieval_method" not in ('operator_statement', 'manual_entry') or "source_records"."attributed_to" is not null

leads_override_has_reason.name: leads_override_has_reason
leads_override_has_reason.value: "leads"."intent_gate_basis" is distinct from 'human_override' or ("leads"."intent_gate_override_by" is not null and "leads"."intent_gate_override_reason" is not null)

scores_axes_range.name: scores_axes_range
scores_axes_range.value: coalesce("scores"."opportunity_axis", 0) between 0 and 100 and coalesce("scores"."intent_axis", 0) between 0 and 100

benchmark_cases_judgement_is_blind.name: benchmark_cases_judgement_is_blind
benchmark_cases_judgement_is_blind.value:
("benchmark_cases"."human_judgement_id" is null) = ("benchmark_cases"."human_judgement_context" is null)
        and "benchmark_cases"."human_judgement_context" is distinct from 'review'

benchmark_cases_comparison_complete.name: benchmark_cases_comparison_complete
benchmark_cases_comparison_complete.value: "benchmark_cases"."outcome" is null or ("benchmark_cases"."human_judgement_id" is not null and "benchmark_cases"."system_score_id" is not null and "benchmark_cases"."system_lead_state" is not null and "benchmark_cases"."compared_at" is not null)

benchmark_cases_disagreement_diagnosed.name: benchmark_cases_disagreement_diagnosed
benchmark_cases_disagreement_diagnosed.value: "benchmark_cases"."outcome" is null or "benchmark_cases"."outcome" = 'agreement' or "benchmark_cases"."diagnosis" is not null

csv_import_rows_invalid_has_reason.name: csv_import_rows_invalid_has_reason
csv_import_rows_invalid_has_reason.value: "csv_import_rows"."status" not in ('invalid', 'failed') or (cardinality("csv_import_rows"."issue_codes") > 0 and "csv_import_rows"."issue_detail" is not null)

public.company_roots.definition:
with recursive chain (company_id, current_id, depth) as (
    select id, id, 0 from companies
    union all
    select chain.company_id, c.merged_into_id, chain.depth + 1
    from chain join companies c on c.id = chain.current_id
    where c.merged_into_id is not null and chain.depth < 50
  )
  select distinct on (company_id) company_id, current_id as root_id, depth
  from chain order by company_id, depth desc
public.company_roots.name: company_roots

public.evidence_provenance.definition:
select e.id as evidence_id, e.company_id, e.claim_key, e.claim, e.claim_type, e.value,
         e.producer, e.observed_at, e.superseded_by_id, e.source_record_id,
         coalesce(sr.final_url, sr.url) as source_url, sr.fetched_at as retrieved_at,
         sr.retrieval_method, sr.attributed_to
  from evidence e
  join source_records sr on sr.id = e.source_record_id
public.evidence_provenance.name: evidence_provenance
